svg.desc: Dee's bedroom, seen from the corner: a lilac bookshelf, a record player on a mustard cabinet, toy cars on a shelf over the bed, a ginger cat asleep on a checkerboard bedspread, a girl with headphones reading on the floor beside the bed, a calico cat on the rug, a desk with a retro laptop under the window and an old TV beside it
